title: Creatify Alternatives for AI Video Ads in 2026
summary: Compare Creatify alternatives by job: product-link tools, AI actor apps, presenter video and done-for-you services. Facts from each company's site, Oct 27, 2026.
body_markdown:
## Self-serve AI video ad tools


These tools are closest to Creatify Platform: you write or approve the script, generate takes, edit and review. They differ in where the ad starts.


### TopView: an agent that plans the ad from a URL or reference


As of October 2026, TopView describes itself as an AI video agent for short films and marketing videos. You add an idea, script, reference video or product URL, and it plans scenes, picks models, generates assets and keeps each shot editable on a canvas. It says it makes UGC-style ads with AI presenters, and that it can analyze a reference video's style, rhythm, shot structure and hooks to recreate its creative direction. The[TopView pricing page](https://www.topview.ai/pricing) lists Plus at $36 a month billed annually ($432 a year) with 100 credits a month, and says unused credits do not roll over to the next month.


**Consider it when** you want to adapt an ad structure that already works, or want planning and generation in one workspace. Creatify's Ad Clone (Pro and above) also remakes an ad from a URL, so test both on the same reference. Only recreate ads you have the right to use.


### Higgsfield Marketing Studio: product commercials from a link


As of October 2026, Higgsfield's Marketing Studio makes six formats: product shots, UGC videos, ads, marketplace images, posters and motion graphics. You paste a link to your website or social profile and the product loads, or you upload photos. Video modes include TV Spot, UGC, Tutorial, Product Review, Unboxing, virtual try-on and Hyper Motion (a CGI product commercial with no people). Presenters come from an avatar library or can be generated, then pinned for reuse across campaigns. The page says generated content can run in paid campaigns, subject to Higgsfield's Terms of Use, and that each generation shows its credit cost before it runs. The[Higgsfield pricing page](https://higgsfield.ai/pricing) did not show plan amounts when we checked, so confirm the price there.


**Consider it when** the product's look carries the sale and you want commercial-style or try-on shots rather than a talking presenter.


### MakeUGC: AI actors holding your product


As of October 2026, MakeUGC describes a studio for UGC ads, product videos, cinematic clips and image ads. You can start from one of its 1,000+ AI actors, a clone of yourself, a prompt, a product URL or a reference ad, and add a product photo for the actor to hold. It also lists a batch mode for 10 variations at once and voices in 50+ languages. The[MakeUGC pricing page](https://makeugc.ai/pricing) lists Starter at $29 a month billed yearly (500 credits, 480p or 720p export, 300+ actors) and Growth at $39 a month billed yearly (1,000 credits, up to 4K export). Any plan can be tried for $1 and renews at the plan price unless you cancel. Enterprise is custom-priced and includes Managed by MakeUGC, where a strategist runs production for you.


**Consider it when** the product needs to be in a presenter's hand. Starter tops out at 720p, so check the export resolution you need first.


### Arcads: a large AI actor library for scripted UGC


As of October 2026, Arcads' homepage offers a library of 1,000+ AI actors, or you can generate your own actor and have it hold your product, show your app or wear your clothes. It lists AI tools to edit, translate, extend, subtitle, upscale and remix video. The[Arcads FAQ](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17350051-arcads-faq) says talking actors speak 74 languages and are based on real actors who consented and are paid for their likeness. It describes a 72-hour trial with 1,000 credits; a card is required but not charged during the trial, and the Starter monthly plan begins if you do not cancel. Its[pricing help article](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17595066-how-does-arcads-pricing-work) lists monthly credits from 8,000 on Starter to 192,000 on Business, says current prices are shown in the app and says yearly billing is 20% off. No public dollar price was published.


**Consider it when** you want many variations of one scripted message across different AI actors, and someone on your team will review every output.


### HeyGen: presenter videos and translation


As of October 2026, HeyGen's homepage centers on avatars, including a personal avatar of you, a prompt-based Video Agent, and video translation with lip-sync across 175+ languages and dialects. The homepage does not mention ads specifically. The[HeyGen pricing page](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) lists a free plan (3 watermarked videos a month, up to 1 minute each), Creator at $29 a month ($24 a month billed annually) with 600 credits and 1080p export, and Pro at $49 a month with 1,000 credits and 4K export.


**Consider it when** a founder or spokesperson avatar should deliver the message, or you need the same ad in several languages.


## Done-for-you services


Self-serve tools leave scripting, retries, editing and review with your team. A done-for-you service moves that production work to the vendor; you supply product facts and approve the ads. MakeUGC's Enterprise plan includes a managed option, as noted above. Knowlify, our top pick above, and Creatify Studio, below, are built entirely around managed production.


### Creatify Studio: Creatify's own managed team


If you like Creatify's approach but lack the time to operate it, Studio is the option that keeps you with the same company. As of October 2026, the Studio page describes human-led strategy with AI-powered production in four stages: onboarding and strategy, production, human QA and brand review, then delivery and iteration. It says a creative expert reviews every ad before it ships and that you can request unlimited revisions, same day, through a dashboard. The pricing page lists 25 to 100+ videos a month with a 48-hour turnaround and says Studio is built for DTC brands, apps and game studios. Neither page publishes a plan price; the Studio page's comparison table puts Studio's cost at $100 to $200 per video, and both pages ask you to book a demo.


**Consider it when** Creatify's output already suits you and you want a team to run production. Ask directly whether campaign management is part of the scope.


## How to choose a Creatify alternative


Start with two questions: where does your ad begin, and who on your team will do the work each week? Then match the answer to a shortlist.


Your situation Shortlist


Finished Meta ads every week, with optional campaign management Knowlify (our top pick)


You like starting from a product link but want a different workflow TopView or Higgsfield Marketing Studio


The product must be in a presenter's hand MakeUGC, or Arcads with a custom actor


Many scripted variations across AI actors Arcads or MakeUGC


One spokesperson video in several languages HeyGen


You like Creatify, but nobody has time to run it Creatify Studio


A few ads for one test on a small budget A self-serve free plan or trial


Then test your top two on the same brief before committing:


1. **Fix the inputs.** Use the same product facts, approved claims, images, script, target length and call to action in both.
2. **Record the full path.** Note credits used, attempts, editing hours and review rounds, not only the first render.
3. **Score against the brief.** Check product accuracy, claims, pronunciation, captions and the export format you need.
4. **Check rights.** Confirm each tool's terms cover paid ads and how its presenters were made.
5. **Price the same unit.** Compare cost per ad that passes review, not plan prices.


A plan price is not a price per ad: credits buy generations, and a usable ad can take several, plus your team's scripting, review and editing time. Our[DIY versus done-for-you cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/diy-ai-video-ads-vs-done-for-you) shows how to turn a plan price, or a service quote, into a cost per approved ad.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for teams that want finished Facebook and Instagram ads every week without running a tool, with optional Meta campaign management.
- If you prefer self-serve, pick the alternative by job: TopView or Higgsfield for product-link ads, Arcads or MakeUGC for AI actor UGC, HeyGen for presenters and translation.
- As of October 2026, the lowest published paid prices in the table run from $15 to $36 a month, but credits buy generations, not finished ads.
- If you like Creatify but lack time to run it, Creatify Studio is its managed option.
- Test two options on one brief and compare cost per approved ad.


## FAQ


### What is the closest alternative to Creatify?


For Creatify's product-link workflow, as of October 2026, TopView and Higgsfield's Marketing Studio both start from a product URL, and MakeUGC can too. For AI actors delivering a script, compare Arcads and MakeUGC. Run the same brief through two of them before choosing. If you would rather receive finished ads than run any tool, our top pick is Knowlify.


### Is there a free alternative to Creatify?


As of October 2026, HeyGen lists a free plan with 3 watermarked videos a month, MakeUGC lets you try any plan for $1, and Arcads offers a 72-hour trial that requires a card. Creatify itself has a free plan with 10 credits a month and watermarked exports.


### Is Creatify Studio the same as Creatify's software?


No. Studio is a managed service in which Creatify's team handles strategy, scripting and production, and a person reviews every ad. The Platform plans are self-serve. Compare Studio with other done-for-you services rather than with software plans.


### Is Knowlify an app like Creatify?


No. Knowlify is a done-for-you agency: our team scripts and produces the ads with AI, checks every one and delivers about 25 a week, with optional campaign management in your own Meta ad account. If you want to run a tool yourself, choose a self-serve option. To discuss a quote,[book a 30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) .
